$\Omega$ 即 $\begin{cases}0\leq\theta\leq 2\pi\\0\leq\varphi\leq\frac{\pi}{4}\\0\leq r\leq\sqrt{2}\end{cases}$，

原式 $=\iiint_\Omega x^2\,dv+\iiint_\Omega z\,dv=\frac{1}{2}\iiint_\Omega(x^2+y^2)\,dv+\iiint_\Omega z\,dv$

$=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_0^{\sqrt{2}}r^4\sin^3\varphi\,dr+\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_0^{\sqrt{2}}r^3\cos\varphi\sin\varphi$

$=\frac{4\sqrt{2}}{5}\pi\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin^3\varphi\,d\varphi+2\pi\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin\varphi\cos\varphi\,d\varphi$

$=\frac{4\sqrt{2}\pi}{5}(\frac{\cos^3\varphi}{3}-\cos\varphi)\big|_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}+\frac{\pi}{2}=\frac{16\sqrt{2}-5}{30}\pi$。
